ciara: Heads-up — hitting mypy failures in the Python sampleapp onboarding flow. The autogen models put auth/session context as `Any` in runtime but the stub types are Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] which makes AsyncClient usage produce TypeErrors in strict mypy runs. This is blocking some new hires.

sam: Oof. Can you paste a tiny repro and what mypy/version you ran?

ciara: repro below, using mypy 1.9.0 + pyright in CI too.

```py
# sample app snippet (simplified)
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key="${REDACTED}")

async def main():
    async with client.auth.session() as sess:
        # sess is typed as Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] in stubs
        token = sess.get("token")
        # mypy complains: "Optional[Mapping] has no attribute \"get\""
```

ciara: error: "[attr-defined] \"get\" not found on Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]"

leo: Hmm. The autogen pydantic model for AuthSessionContext is currently generated as `Optional[dict]` at runtime but the stub generator emits `Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]`. That's usually OK, but the real issue is the context manager typed return is `Optional[AuthSessionContext]` instead of `AuthSessionContext` (we default to None for non-auth case). Sampleapp expects context manager to yield a dict.

maya: So users who do `async with client.auth.session() as sess:` then treat sess as truthy dict get burned. Two quick fixes: change stubs to `Mapping[str, Any]` + annotate `__aenter__` to return Mapping (not Optional) and let runtime raise if None; or update sampleapp to `if not sess: return` checks.

sam: Can we coordinate a fix that won't break existing users? Which change is least breaking?

leo: Least breaking is to narrow the stub to `Mapping[str, Any]` and in the runtime ensure we always yield an empty mapping ({}), never None. That keeps behavior stable and keeps typing ergonomic. I'll sketch a PR against autogen templates.

ciara: Sounds good. Can you also add a small mypy test case to the sampleapp CI? New hires are running strict checks.

leo: Yep. Will add a test and a changelog note. Will target a small patch: autogen -> session typing + runtime yield fallback to {}.

maya: FYI pyright flagged a slightly different issue: `async with` context return is `Any` (no attribute suggestions). We should improve stub docstrings too so editors show correct completions.

sam: Please open a GH issue so we can track across SDK, autogen, and sampleapp. Also assign to eng-ml for autogen template touch.

ciara: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3184 — describes repro, mypy/pyright output, and suggested fix.

devx-bot: Issue created: #3184 by @ciara — https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3184 :white_check_mark:

leo: I'm taking the issue. Will propose a PR with: 1) change stub typing to Mapping[str, Any], 2) runtime change to always yield {} instead of None, 3) add mypy test and update sampleapp snippet.

maya: I'll review and add a small VSCode/pyright unit so editor completions improve.

ciara: Thanks all — this was blocking the onboarding run this morning. Appreciate the fast turnaround :pray: 

sam: Nice, thanks @leo and @maya. Once PR lands can we backport to the last release branch? New hires are on that pinned version for now.

leo: Will include backport plan in PR description.

ciara: Marking this as high-priority for onboarding.
